# Lens sources, views and field surfaces: is this moment mine?

## What this region is

The input side of the rule builder: the serializable source a server ships, the narrowed lens that gates every rule, the view the builder reads scope by scope, what each scope offers as fields, operators and value shapes, and how a rule is stored together with that source.

## What it exists for

- Pick the entry that turns a rule into a tree a renderer walks
- Type the permission, transition and saved-rule shapes without extra dependencies
- Turn a source or a lens into what the builder reads or gates with
- Address one scope of a view and ask what it shows
- Decide what the source exposes and to whom
- Learn what a field picker and its value slot may offer
- Give a field a dropdown of the values that really occur
- Walk a lens for a picker outside the rule tree
- Store a rule and load it back with what it was built against

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- keep the condition in state and re-render the editor on every change → rule-builder-and-condition-tree
- hoist Annual Revenue from a related model to the top of the field picker → decoration-facets-and-presets
- wrap the selected rows in a new OR group → rule-builder-and-condition-tree
- edit which roles may update an invoice in the permission schema → permission-and-transition-builders
- show Salesforce and Gong custom fields as separate named sources in the picker → decoration-facets-and-presets
